title: The ORM ``Session`` is imported from ``sqlmodel``, never from ``sqlalchemy``
intent: SQLModel re-exports SQLAlchemy's ``Session``, and the framework standardises on that one everywhere — ``SessionDep``, ``BaseService``, the write guard, and the migrations all speak ``sqlmodel.Session``. Importing ``Session`` from ``sqlalchemy`` / ``sqlalchemy.orm`` quietly forks the app onto a second session type, so the rule names the one canonical import. (Constructing a session is separately banned by ``no_raw_session_construction`` — this only fixes the spelling.)
